PRE-STAGING COMPLETE (2026-07-18). All tag gates are now satisfied; only the R5 tag itself remains, user-gated.

R1 (cc-guides): kinds-registry refactor + TOML kind shipped as v0.1.30 (8 commits, fast-forward on main). Declarative Spec registry (guide/spec.go) replaced all seven kind switches; official cgo tree-sitter syntax validators + native semantic hooks; go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 migration; TOML = pure registry entry (Append, "# " marker, post-compose duplicate-table validation, non-first fragments must open with a table header). Verified: full pinned suite green with zero pre-existing-test edits; codex finder+refuter rounds (darwin minos 12.0 deployment-target regression found+fixed+CI-asserted, incl. cache-keyed CGO flags); fleet parity harness 42/42 repos byte-identical old-vs-new; zig-CGO goreleaser + 4-leg published-binary smoke matrix all green (incl. macos-15-intel darwin/amd64).

R2 (cc-skills 7d6de6fa): six shared fragments in plugin/guides/toml/ (capt-hook-base/python/go/cc-notes/cc-present/ccx), lint green, README documents the fifth kind.

R3 (fleet): 37/37 repos rendered+pushed+origin-verified (tomllib set-parity rendered [packs.*] == legacy packs.toml at the remote SHA, every lane). Roster: /tmp/r3-roster.jsonl + /tmp/r3-verify-results.json. fusekit-f3 = local-only non-git dir, hand-written consumer file on disk. captain-hook deliberately NOT rendered — its .claude/capt-hook.toml arrives via the R5 merge itself (rendering on main would add/add-conflict the merge); cc-guides adoption moves to R6. Legacy packs.toml kept everywhere.

R4 (all 6 pack sources, additive releases pushed): getaway 1.0.1 dcebdda (cut BEFORE its consumer render, ordering honored), cc-notes 0.11.1 bd2d0c51 (+ net-new captain-hook dep + marketplace allowlist), cc-present 0.10.1 e1d6ed5, cc-context 0.28.1 60e3c1b9, cc-guides plugin 0.1.1 75864b2, show@cc-skills 0.1.7 98565b70 (+ net-new dep + cc-skills allowlist). Scope discovery: dual-role repos ship TWO manifests (repo-level .claude/capt-hook.toml for external fetch AND plugin/hooks/capt-hook.toml in the installed plugin) — BOTH made dual-grammar. Every plugin root verified: 9.x PyPI load green, 10.x branch resolve_manifest green, pack lint 5-ok/1-fail where the single fail is the expected pre-cleanup attach line.

KNOWN TRANSITIONAL STATE (expected, fix = R6 cleanup releases): getaway CI's hooks job (uvx 'capt-hook>=9.9.0' pack lint) goes RED once 10.0.0 publishes, until the attach-line cleanup release — sequence R6 promptly after the tag.
